concerns.text: The plan computes Variance Inflation Factors (VIF) on the CLR‑transformed taxonomic matrix (Phase 2 – Imputation & Normalization, step 6). Because CLR values are constrained to sum to zero across taxa, they are inherently collinear, making VIF undefined or artificially inflated. Using VIF as a diagnostic for multicollinearity on CLR data is methodologically unsound in compositional data analysis.
